entities.name: Erg Mirab
entities.description: A large desert in the center of South Aerona.

entities.name: The Aerie
entities.description: Cliff dwelling at the heart of the Mirab, ancestral home of the Haari Clan.

entities.name: Indorin's Tomb
entities.description: Monument to a fallen knight in the Mirab mountains.

entities.name: Haari Clan
entities.description: A tribe of warrior thieves who fly using the Form.

entities.name: Old Ones
entities.description: Beings who legend says granted the Haari the Task; possibly the Thran.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Possibly the Old Ones, so called by the Fallaji.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: People who called the Thran the Old Ones.

events.summary: Haari youth undertake the Hunt, a Lone Flight stealing a Gift for the tribe, and become hunters with a seat at High Council.
events.quote: they undertake the Hunt, in which they perform a Lone Flight and steal an item, called the Gift, for the tribe

relations.quote: In the heart of the Mirab lies the Aerie

relations.note: Legend says the Old Ones granted them the Task
